title: Invoicing a Micro Market's Product Settlement for a Settlement Period
content:
A micro market in the Unattended Micro Market Program whose market format settles on a subsidy true-up basis is invoiced a product settlement for each settlement period. The charge is placed on that period's settlement invoice, where it joins the equipment line and whatever else stands on the invoice, and the balance owing on the agreement rises by it.

## A condition on the period's figure

The settlement invoiced for a period is not worked out before the agreement's drawdown record carries the client discount owed for every kiosk trip the till failed to meet. While the agreement's drawdown record is short of the discount owed for any such trip, the settlement for that period is not yet worked out.

## Raising the charge

The tool `post_market_settlement_true_up_13e3670a` raises the charge. It is an agent-side tool: the desk unlocks it and then calls it, one call adding a single monthly settlement charge to the named settlement invoice on that agreement's ledger.

### Parameters

- `market_agreement_id` — the reference number identifying the micro market agreement being invoiced, as returned by the micro market agreement lookup.
- `invoice_reference` — the settlement invoice the charge is placed on, written as INV-MK- followed by 6 digits exactly as it is printed on the invoice. An empty value is not accepted.
- `service_period` — the settlement period the charge covers, written as YYYY-MM with no other text. An empty value is not accepted.
- `settlement_amount_usd` — the product settlement to invoice for that period, in USD to 2 decimal places, rounded to the nearest cent at the point of booking, a figure falling exactly on the half-cent going to the nearest even cent. A negative value is not accepted.

### Return

A single confirmation sentence in plain text, carrying the reference number minted for the new settlement charge, the settlement invoice it was placed on, and the amount invoiced in USD to two decimal places. Receiving that sentence means the charge is on the invoice; no other outcome is reported.

## The effect on the client's account

Afterwards the client sees the settlement charge on the invoice alongside the equipment line, and the balance owing on the agreement rises accordingly.
